title: Update heading and tile colors to match logo and background

requirements.summary: Change all heading colors from green to match the LivSpan logo color tone
acceptanceCriteria: All headings use the logo's color tone instead of green
Gradient utilities in CSS are updated to reflect logo colors
Visual consistency is maintained across all dashboard panels and components

file_operations.description: Extract the dominant color palette from the LivSpan logo assets (frontend/public/assets/generated/livspan-logo.dim_512x512.png) and replace the current green gradient utilities (.text-gradient-glow, .text-gradient-timer) with new gradient definitions using the logo's color tone. Update the OKLCH color values in the gradient-from and gradient-to properties to match the logo palette while maintaining the existing dark mode structure and OKLCH color system.

Update the custom helix-themed color palette in the Tailwind config to use colors derived from the LivSpan logo instead of the current green tones. Replace color values in the extend.colors section that are currently green-based with the logo's color palette, ensuring the sage palette and other theme colors harmonize with the new heading colors.

Update heading text classes that currently use text-gradient-timer or text-gradient-glow to ensure they use the newly defined logo-based gradient utilities from index.css. Verify visual consistency with the updated color scheme.

Update heading text classes that currently use text-gradient-glow or other green-based gradient classes to use the newly defined logo-based gradient utilities. Ensure headings are visually consistent with the updated color scheme.

Update any heading or title elements that use green-based gradient classes to use the newly defined logo-based gradient utilities from index.css. Ensure the main dashboard headings reflect the logo color tone.

requirements.summary: Adjust tile colors to harmonize with the DNA helix background
acceptanceCriteria: FactorMarker tiles have colors that harmonize with the DNA helix background
Sufficient contrast is maintained for readability
Hover and selection states remain visually clear

file_operations.description: Update the FactorMarker card styling to use colors that harmonize with the DNA helix background (frontend/public/assets/generated/dna-helix-dashboard-bokeh.dim_1440x2560.png and livspan-dna-helix-bg.dim_1440x2560.png). Adjust the base card background, border colors, and opacity values to complement the background while maintaining sufficient contrast for readability. Update hover and selection state colors (currently using green-blue gradients) to align with the new logo-based palette. Ensure the selected state gradient and hover effects remain visually distinct.

Add or update custom color definitions that support the FactorMarker component's new harmonized color scheme. Define background, border, and accent colors that complement the DNA helix background assets while maintaining the OKLCH color system and dark mode structure.
